confidence_notes: Meals, coffee and beer rest on aggregator cost-of-living figures from web searches (Numbeo Oct 2026: about E£1,200, roughly US$25, for a mid-range three-course meal for two; Livingcost: cappuccino about US$1.73, pub beer about US$2.87; MyLifeElsewhere: domestic beer about US$3.12, basic restaurant meal about US$8.31). I nudged these up modestly for tourist-area pricing. No direct cocktail or wine-by-the-glass prices were found, so they are set at about 2x and 1.6x the domestic beer price. Accommodation is a holistic model estimate from general knowledge, with no listings or booking pages checked. Sharm's hostel supply is thin, so the hostel anchors are the least certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Egypt-wide price levels scaled up for Sharm's resort-town premium; aggregators show Sharm restaurant prices well above the Egyptian average and Cairo. Accommodation is judged against other Egyptian Red Sea resort towns such as Hurghada and Dahab, from general knowledge. Region is set to Middle East because Sharm sits on the Sinai peninsula.
